newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish Jan-Aug budget deficit rises six-fold.
newsitem.headline: Turkish Jan-Aug budget deficit rises six-fold.

text.p: Turkey's budget deficit rose about six-fold to 660 trillion lira in January-August this year from 109.3 trillion lira in the same 1995 period, the treasury said on Friday.
The consolidated deficit was 564 trillion lira in the January-July period.
The government's target for the whole 1996 is 1,300 trillion lira, revised upwards from 860 trillion lira estimated earlier.
The treasury said budget revenues were 1,580 trillion lira and expenditures 2,240 trillion lira in the January-August period.
